source_caption_data.pre_caption: This high-angle full shot captures a simulated interview scene. Initially, an interviewer and interviewee are positioned in the right middle ground, while a three-person camera crew is arranged in the left foreground and middle ground. A crew member in a red shirt stands in the center-left foreground, with another crew member operating a camera on a tripod to his left in the middle ground, and a third standing on the far left. The camera then executes a slow, counterclockwise arc, moving from right to left. This movement causes the interview subjects to shift toward the right edge of the frame, while the camera crew and their equipment, including a large light stand, move more toward the center. A large white curtain hangs in the background, and a light-colored wooden floor occupies the bottom of the frame throughout the shot.
